The '''skeletons''' in [[Melzar's Maze]] are the result of [[Melzar the Mad]]'s attempts to revive those that died on [[Elvarg]]'s attack on [[Crandor]]. While he was successful in reanimating their bones, they are mindless, having none of their original personality.

They are found on the {{FloorNumber|3}}, and are encountered during the [[Dragon Slayer]] quest. One of the skeletons, which can be identified by its round shield, drops the [[Key (yellow)|yellow key]] required to progress down to the basement, home of the [[zombie]]s.
